lines: “二十岁就死了，可惜了。”
陆远轻声念叨一句，又补了句：“来柱香吧。”
洋火儿划过，幽蓝的火苗跳动。
陆远点燃三根香，对着面前孤零零的坟头拜了三拜。
“这可是我们地球泰山玉皇殿的头香，皇帝老儿当年都用这个，好东西哩。”
“便宜你了。”
说完，陆远将三根香稳稳插进坟头的泥土里。
香插好。
嘶~
一股阴风顺着后脖颈子就钻了进来。
陆远拧了拧脖子，骨节发出一阵脆响。
这感觉，阴恻恻的……
他还没来得及细想，身后就传来急促的脚步声和喘气声。
“陆哥儿，这边儿的坟头，香都上完嘞！”
陆远回头。
一胖一瘦两个少年郎，正朝他跑来，脸上带着半大孩子特有的憨气。
胖的叫许二小，瘦的叫王成安。
两人是他在关外这个小破道观的师弟。
陆远是大师兄。
“行，找个地儿歇着。”
陆远掸了掸道袍下摆的尘土，言简意赅。
“等天黑，逮它。”
他迈步朝旁边一棵枯树下走去。
许二小和王成安赶忙跟上，一边从怀里掏出梆硬的干粮，一边压低了声音，满眼都是好奇。
“陆哥儿，那徐老太爷……当真变成僵尸啦？”
陆远脚步一顿，目光越过荒芜的坟地，落向远处一座气派非凡的石碑。
那石碑上，一行常人看不见的血色文字，正幽幽浮现。
【姓名：徐成玄】
【类型：僵尸】
【道行：四十八年】
【弱点：雷，电，火】
【危险级别：★☆】
这，便是陆远穿越一年来，安身立命的本钱。
陆远收回目光，在树下盘腿坐好，撕开自己的干粮。
“包的。”
陆远语气笃定。
“今晚十点，一准儿从棺材里坐起来。”
听到这话，许二小和王成安对视一眼，立刻没了怀疑，也跟着坐了下来。
虽然刚才他们转了一圈，手里的罗盘屁反应没有，鼻子里也没闻到半点尸气。
但比起祖师爷传下的吃饭家伙，他们更信陆哥儿。
因为陆哥儿，从来没错过。
“陆哥儿，过年没地儿去，上俺家耍呗？”
content_en:
"It's a pity to die at the age of twenty."
Lu Yuan muttered something softly and then added: "Come on the incense sticks."
Cha——
The match flashed across, and the blue flames danced.
Lu Yuan lit three incense sticks and bowed three times to the lonely grave in front of him.
"This is the top fragrance of the Jade Emperor's Palace in Mount Tai on Earth. The emperor used this in his past. It's a good thing."
"It's easier on you."
After speaking, Lu Yuan firmly inserted the three incense sticks into the soil of the grave.
The incense is inserted.
Hiss~
A gloomy wind came in along the back of his neck.
Lu Yuan twisted his neck, and his joints made a crisp sound.
This feeling is so sad...
Before he had time to think about it, there were rapid footsteps and gasps behind him.
"Brother Lu, the incense has been put on the grave here!"
Lu Yuan turned around.
Two young men, one fat and one thin, were running towards him, with the unique naivety of half-grown children on their faces.
The fat one is called Xu Erxiao, and the thin one is called Wang Chengan.
The two of them were his junior brothers in this small Taoist temple outside the pass.
Lu Yuan is the senior brother.
"Okay, find a place to rest."
Lu Yuan dusted off the dust from the hem of his Taoist robe and spoke concisely.
"Catch it when it gets dark."
He walked towards a dead tree nearby.
Xu Erxiao and Wang Chengan hurriedly followed, taking out the hard dry food from their arms and lowering their voices, their eyes full of curiosity.
"Brother Lu, did Mr. Xu...really turn into a zombie?"
Lu Yuan paused and looked across the deserted cemetery to an extraordinary stone monument in the distance.
On the stone tablet, a line of bloody words invisible to ordinary people was faintly emerging.
[Name: Xu Chengxuan]
[Type: Zombie]
[Taoxing: Forty-eight years]
[Weaknesses: Thunder, Electricity, Fire]
[Distance from breaking out of the coffin: 11:58:35]
[Danger level: ★☆]
This is what Lu Yuan has been able to rely on for a year of time travel.
Lu Yuan withdrew his gaze, sat cross-legged under the tree, and tore open his own dry food.
"It's covered."
Lu Yuan's tone was determined.
"Sit up from the coffin at ten o'clock tonight."
Hearing this, Xu Erxiao and Wang Chengan looked at each other, immediately lost their suspicion, and sat down.
Although they had just turned around in a circle, there was no reaction from the compass in their hands, and there was no smell of corpse gas in their noses.
But they trust Brother Lu more than the food guy passed down from their ancestors.
Because Brother Lu never misses anything.
"Brother Lu, you don't have anywhere to go during the Chinese New Year, so why don't you come to my house to play?"
